# f5xc_discovery_download_certificates (Data Source)

DownloadCertificates Download the cerificates files for the Log Collerctor In order to establish connection from the third party application server to the Log Colletor the user should download a zip file with the certificates files: - client.crt - client.key - server_ca.crt
